name: test_customer_can_complete_checkout[webkit]
description:
Verify that an authenticated customer can purchase a seeded product.

Flow:
    customer
        -> Shop
        -> add product to cart
        -> Cart
        -> Checkout
        -> verify saved billing details
        -> select Cash on delivery
        -> add order note
        -> place order
        -> verify order confirmation
